Name: Group Chat - Immersive NPC Group Conversations
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4][b]GROUP CHAT[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Talk to one villager. Let the whole group join in.[/size][/center]

[center][size=2]Ever walked into a festival and thought:
[i]“Alright... time to click 26 people one by one.”[/i]
Yeah.
[b]No more.[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=2]With [b]Group Chat[/b], talking to one villager can naturally pull nearby villagers into the conversation, one after another[b].[/b]
So instead of:
click Abigail
walk two steps
click Sebastian
click Sam
squeeze past Pierre
click Caroline
accidentally click a chair
forget who you already talked to...
you can just:
[b]walk up to the group → talk once → hear everyone out[/b]
Much better. 😂[/size][/center]

[center][size=2][b]And with V1.1 — Social Circle -[/b] you can now choose whether everyone nearby joins, or only villagers who actually have a believable connection to the person you started talking to.[/size][/center]

[size=3][b]🌱 HOW IT WORKS[/b][/size]
[size=2]Talk to any villager like normal.[/size]
[size=2]If other villagers are nearby, Group Chat gathers them into the conversation.[/size]
[size=2]Your farmer turns toward each person as they speak, and every villager uses their [b]actual available dialogue[/b] — including daily, contextual, festival, and compatible modded dialogue.[/size]
[size=2]Group Chat continues until each participant has said everything they currently have to say.[/size]
[size=2]Then everyone gets back to their day.[/size]
[size=2]Sometimes with a few little emotes afterward. ❤️[/size]


[size=3][b]🫂 NEW IN V1.1 — SOCIAL CIRCLE[/b][/size][size=2]
Social Circle makes Group Chat more relationship-aware.
Nearby villagers can join if they’re connected to the original speaker through:[/size]
[size=2]
- Family
- Living in the same home
- Meaningful heart/story events you’ve already seen[/size]
[size=2]
That last part means Social Circle can actually grow as you progress.
As you unlock more heart events and see villagers meaningfully interact with each other, new believable Social Circle connections can become available.
So progressing relationships now has a little extra payoff beyond the event itself. ❤️[/size]
[size=1](Generic festival attendance doesn’t count, and every villager must connect directly to the original speaker — no friends-of-friends chain-pulling.)[/size]


[size=3][b]🌻 PERFECT FOR FESTIVALS[/b][/size]
[size=2]This is where Group Chat really shines.
At the Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Stardew Valley Fair, Spirit’s Eve and other festivals, villagers are already standing around in little social groups.
So now those groups can actually [b]feel like groups[/b].
Walk over to one cluster.
Talk to somebody.
Everyone nearby gets their turn.
No sprinting around Pelican Town’s entire population like you’re doing attendance.
And importantly:
[b]Group Chat only handles conversation.[/b]
It won’t suddenly:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]start the Egg Hunt[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]trigger the Flower Dance[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]launch a competition[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]open a shop[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]advance the festival[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]make choices for you[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]So you get the convenience [b]without losing control[/b].[/size]


[b]🧸 THREE CONVERSATION MODES[/b][size=2]
Group Chat now has three ways to play:[/size]
[size=2]
[b]👥 GROUP[/b]
ALL nearby group conversations.
The classic Group Chat experience.
Nearby eligible villagers can join regardless of their relationship to the person you started with.

[b]🫂 SOCIAL CIRCLE[/b]
Relationship-based conversations.
Only nearby villagers connected to the original speaker through family, home, or meaningful story progression can join.

[b]👤 SINGLE[/b]
One-on-one conversations.
Only the villager you selected speaks.

Cycle between:
[b]Group → Social Circle → Single → Group[/b]
using either the dialogue-side icon or your configured G hotkey.
If you switch modes during an already-running conversation, that conversation stays exactly as it started.
Your new mode applies to the next conversation.
The mod itself can be enabled or disabled through GMCM.[/size]


[size=3][b]✨ FEATURES[/b][/size]
[size=2]• Talk to one villager and nearby villagers can join
• Three modes: Group / Social Circle / Single
• Social Circle recognises family, shared homes, and meaningful heart/story events
• Social connections can grow as you progress through character events
• Every Social Circle participant must connect directly to the original speaker
• No friends-of-friends chain-pulling
• Fully exhausts available safe dialogue so you don't need to run back and click everyone again
• Farmer turns toward whoever is speaking
• Configurable conversation radius from 2–10 tiles
• Protects questions and personal conversations
• Villagers with something personal to ask may show a ❓
• Questions are skipped so you can answer them manually
• Safe around gifts, shops, services, tools, items, spouses, and special interactions
• Festival-safe during normal free-roam conversation
• Small staggered end-of-conversation emotes
• Quick dialogue-side mode control
• Configurable hotkey for mode cycling
• Lightweight and interaction-driven — no constant world scanning
• Relationship information is cached instead of repeatedly scanned every frame
• Compatible with modded NPCs when their Stardew data provides qualifying relationship information[/size]


[size=3][b]❓ PERSONAL CONVERSATIONS[/b][/size]
[size=2]Sometimes a villager has something they specifically want to ask "you"
Group Chat protects those moments.
If a pending personal question is detected, that villager is excluded from the group conversation and may show a small: [/size]
[size=2]"❓"
above their head.
Talk to them manually and their conversation proceeds normally.
Group Chat never answers questions or makes personal choices for you.[/size]


[b][size=3]❤️ LITTLE SOCIAL MOMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=2]When a successful Group Chat finishes, villagers can react with small staggered emotes afterward.
Nothing dramatic.
Just little:[/size]

[size=2]"❤️♪😊! ..."[/size]
[size=2]
The farmer may react too.
 
These little moments are purely cosmetic, but they help the conversation feel like a shared social moment rather than a sequence of menu boxes.[/size]


[size=3][b]💚 WHY GROUP CHAT?[/b][/size]
[size=2]
Because sometimes the villagers are already standing together.
They already feel like a group.
Now talking to them can feel like one too.[/size]



[left][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]·       [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/size][/left]
